signal: DCI extended real-time payments on the TCH RTP network within its iCore360 core banking platform for community banks

email.body1:
Todd, saw DCI was an early core provider to wire real-time payments into iCore360 over the RTP network.

Leading on payments tends to open more community-bank conversations than a regional team can cover before they cool, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount, 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for DCI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Todd, quick follow-up for DCI.

The community-bank market is broad and relationship-heavy, so reps spend most of their time on research and follow-up instead of in front of prospects. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings DCI needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Todd, last bit of proof for DCI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how DCI's reply rate likely compares to other core-banking and fintech vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Todd, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Covering a broad bank territory is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a community-banking motion? I'll tailor it to DCI either way.
